title: Pure Dark Lucius
match: The Graveyard in the Fourth Dimension
summary: Dark Lucius is an EARTH Fiend LV evolution archetype where Dark Lucius LV4 negates the effects of monsters it destroys by battle to evolve into LV6 and LV8. Once Dark Lucius LV8 reaches the field via battle evolution or Level Up!, it negates the effects of every monster it destroys by battle AND banishes them completely instead of sending them to the GY.

allow.Tour Guide From the Underworld: Level 3 Fiend starter that pairs with Fiendish Rhino Warrior to protect Dark Lucius or make Muckraker.
allow.Fiendish Rhino Warrior: Protects all Fiend monsters you control (including Dark Lucius LV4 and LV6) from being destroyed by battle or card effects.
allow.Moon Mirror Shield: Equip Spell that guarantees Dark Lucius LV4 and LV6 win every battle by setting their ATK to the opponent's monster's ATK + 100, effortlessly triggering their battle evolution.
allow.Burden of the Mighty: Continuous Spell that reduces the ATK of all opposing monsters by 100 x their Level, making it easy for Dark Lucius LV4 to destroy them in battle.
allow.Muckraker From the Underworld: Link-2 Fiend that revives Dark Lucius LV4 or LV6 from the GY.

main: Dark Lucius LV4
Base EARTH Fiend LV monster that negates the effects of any opponent's monster it destroys by battle, then sends itself to the GY during the next Standby Phase to summon LV6.
Dark Lucius LV6
Mid-tier LV monster that negates the GY effects of any monster it destroys by battle (if summoned by LV4's effect) and evolves into LV8 during the next Standby Phase.
Dark Lucius LV8
2800 ATK boss monster that both negates the effects of and banishes any opponent's monster it destroys by battle (if summoned by LV6 or Level Modulation).
Level Up!
Sends a face-up Dark Lucius LV4 or LV6 to the GY to immediately Special Summon the next higher LV monster from your hand or Deck.
Level Modulation
Special Summons Dark Lucius LV8 from the GY ignoring its summoning conditions.
The Graveyard in the Fourth Dimension
Shuffles 2 LV monsters from your GY back into the Deck so Level Up! and LV4/LV6 always have targets in the Deck.
Fiendish Rhino Warrior
Prevents Dark Lucius LV4 and LV6 from being destroyed by battle or card effects while waiting for the Standby Phase to evolve.
Tour Guide From the Underworld
Summons Fiendish Rhino Warrior directly from the Deck to protect Dark Lucius.
Moon Mirror Shield
Guarantees Dark Lucius LV4 (1000 ATK) wins every single battle so its battle evolution effect is always live.
Burden of the Mighty
Weakens all opposing monsters based on their Level to help Dark Lucius dominate combat.
extra: Link-2 Fiend that discards a card to revive Dark Lucius LV4 or LV6 from the GY.
